name: vetnest-monorepo
description: VetNest - Dual-portal veterinary real-time crowd heat-mapping & OPD management monorepo for Bengaluru

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend-owner && npm install --prefix frontend-staff
scripts.build: npm run build:owner && npm run build:staff
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run start:owner" "npm run start:staff"
